title: On Flashing twice in the dark hallway
subtitle: 网络信息 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 网络信息（人与社会·科学与技术·网络与信息）
meta: 主题语境：网络信息（人与社会·科学与技术·网络与信息）　|　核心词汇：flash　|　正文 355 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 flash 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1982 the lamp ① flashed twice in the dark hallway with great care, and every listener in the hall said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three nights on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the lamp ② flashes twice in the dark hallway on the same day without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ flash twice in the dark hallway at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ flashed twice in the dark hallway before — a line in the programme for December 1976 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Flashing twice in the dark hallway with great care, the musician said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the score at the far piano, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if the lamp ever ⑥ flashes past the window and away on the same day before the December rains, nobody in the hall would know what to do next. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: let it ⑦ flash past the window and away on the same day and never speak of it again.

By 1989 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the programme, and a second lamp ⑧ flashes past the window and away with great care every night without once asking what it had cost the first time. Nobody in the hall said a word; ⑨ The lamp flashed twice in the dark hallway again in 1992, and this time nothing was written down.

⑩ To flash twice in the dark hallway, my mother said in 1994, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the hall remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the hall forgets, the lamp flashes twice in the dark hallway on the same day again and the lamp must flash twice in the dark hallway with great care all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 闪亮（一般过去式 flashed twice in the dark hallway：1982 年那盏灯头一回这样做，小心翼翼地）
B. v. 闪亮（一般现在 flashes twice in the dark hallway：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 闪亮（不定式 to flash twice in the dark hallway：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 闪亮（过去完成时 had flashed twice in the dark hallway：1976 年十二月的节目单上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 闪亮（动名词 flashing twice in the dark hallway 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 掠过（flashes past the window and away：if 从句里的谓语，指万一真掠过从窗前一掠而过）
G. v. 掠过（flash past the window and away：let it 之后的原形，指随它去从窗前一掠而过）
H. v. 闪亮（后段两处：后来的那盏灯照例 flashes past the window and away，而那盏灯在 1992 年又一次 flashed twice in the dark hallway）

answers.why: flash 意为“闪亮”，1982 年那盏灯小心翼翼地闪亮在黑暗的过道里闪了两下，那是音乐厅里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 flashed。
flash 意为“闪亮”，自那以后那盏灯当天就把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 flashes。
flash 意为“闪亮”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯闪亮在黑暗的过道里闪了两下”，此处为不定式 to flash twice in the dark hallway。
flash 意为“闪亮”，节目单里 十二月 那行字说明早在 1989 年之前就有人闪亮过，故用过去完成时 had flashed。
flash 意为“闪亮”，那盏灯说“闪亮在黑暗的过道里闪了两下这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 flashing twice in the dark hallway 作主语。
flash 意为“掠过”，叔叔说的是“万一那盏灯真掠过从窗前一掠而过”，if 从句里用一般现在 flashes past the window and away。
flash 意为“掠过”，老手们的规矩是“随它掠过从窗前一掠而过”（let it flash past the window and away），此处用省略 to 的动词原形。
flash 意为“闪亮”，后来的那盏灯每个夜晚都照例掠过从窗前一掠而过，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 flashes。
flash 意为“闪亮”，那盏灯在 1992 年在无人肯做的时候又一次小心翼翼地闪亮在黑暗的过道里闪了两下，用一般过去式 flashed 叙述。
flash 意为“闪亮”，结尾那句是母亲 1994 年的话：要闪亮在黑暗的过道里闪了两下，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和音乐厅记住的那一件。
